rationale: Greek loanword from ἀλλάσσω 'change, exchange,' Lycopolitan reduplicated form ⲭⲁⲗⲗⲁⲭ-. Fits Manichaean register of metempsychosis/transmigration where souls are 'exchanged' through bodily reincarnation in the realm of the Enemy. Pair-partner with accumulated ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲗⲗⲁⲥⲙⲟⲥ 'exchange/transmutation.'

Hapax on this page; paired with ⲕⲁⲣⲁⲓ̈ⲧϥ̄ ('stillness') as the dyadic state in which the godhood stands. Possibly from ⲧⲱⲧ ⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧ ('persuasion of heart, agreement') with qualitative-like ⲡⲉⲧ-ϩⲏⲧⲧ. Alternative: 'foremost-state' (from ϩⲏⲧ 'front'). Confidence low; flagged for parallels.

Variant orthography of ⲡⲕⲁⲍⲧⲏϩ (in accumulated vocab) — 'trust, confidence' from ⲕⲱⲍ/ⲕⲁⲑⲏⲧ 'be set, established.' Here paired with ⲧϩⲉⲗⲡⲓⲥ 'hope' as the soteriological gift brought to the transmuted souls — same hendiadys-pair as in earlier Pages.

Greek πρόσωπον. Used here as discourse-marker introducing a 'second visage' of the same teaching — i.e., a parallel exegetical framework. 'Hear him from another visage' = 'hear another aspect/side of his teaching.' Standard Greek loanword.
